_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6 object handlers: enemies $1A, $1B and $1C ($9DFA-$9FB7). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: TYPES $1A / $1C (A DIVER AND A FALLER FROM THE TOP): first frame?
regions.description: TYPES $1A / $1C (A DIVER AND A FALLER FROM THE TOP): type bit 7 set goes to the per-frame code (`$9E5C`). Table stats: `$1A` hit points 8, attack 8, art block `$3C`; `$1C` hit points 1, attack 16, art block `$37`; both collision flags 0, drawing flags `$13` (bit 4: **when they leave the screen they are gone for good**, unlike types `$0E`-`$13`), die as type 8.

regions.name: TYPE $1B (A RING OF ORBS; ALSO THE ORBS): first frame?
regions.description: TYPE $1B (A RING OF ORBS; ALSO THE ORBS): bit 7 set goes to the per-frame code (`$9F03`). Table stats: hit points 255, attack 24, flags 0, drawing flags `$13`, art block `$37`. Two ways of being made: **standalone (no `$0728`) it is the RING-MAKER; made by the ring-maker (`$0728` = `$FF`) it is one ORB.**
